notes.how_to_adapt: Replace reference_pdb, template_pdb, template (code + chain), ligand_xml, ligand_resname and mutation_sets with your system. Mutations use the residue numbering of the reference PDB.
notes.wt_model: A silent substitution (K2K) builds the unmutated sequence with MODELLER: it measures how different a modelled WT is from the experimental WT, i.e. the part of any effect that is due to model building and not to the mutation.
notes.design: 4 scenarios x 2 replicas = 8 WT trajectories = 28 WT-vs-WT pairs, enough for the null control to give p <= 0.05 per run.
notes.launch: python -m pert md-panel-config --config configs/custom_panel.example.json   (add --dry-run to see the command)
